sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Mead is a symbolic drink. It is a wine made from honey. Mead appears in many Celtic myths and legends as a drink favored by warriors. Its most consistent mythological link is to the goddess and queen whose name is the same as the drink, Medb. Medb stood for the intoxication and danger of kingship. The name Medb shares its root with this drink.
objective: Document mead, the symbolic honey wine of Celtic myth.
